planningGate.approvalEvidenceRef: 2026-09-14 user request to preserve existing Sagajeong behavior and refactor reusable parts

downwardPlan.summary: The adapter only reports and hides read-only presentation components; existing mobility interpreters and server or Simulation authority remain unchanged.

upwardValidation.summary: Only Unity read-only module reporting and presentation lifetime changed; server, Simulation, WI, workflow and WorldRevision write paths were not modified.

downwardPlan.summary: No Scene, Prefab, camera, mesh or stored GameObject changes are authorized.
Host registration, refresh, detach and visibility restoration are refactored and tested.
Existing traffic and delivery playback components remain the presentation owners and are not rewritten.
One deterministic Mobility contribution wraps zero or one explicitly selected existing playback source; ambiguous multiple sources are rejected.

upwardValidation.summary: Byte-identical main sources passed 10 adapter, 11 host standard, 16 low-density traffic, 27 food-journey and 75 Sagajeong view regression EditMode tests in the isolated Unity project.

The adapter is not connected to production composition or the stored canonical Scene, and Scene, Prefab, mesh and camera output were unchanged; Play Mode and Game View remain a separate binding validation.

runtimeBoundary: Unity read-only station Mobility adapter and visibility lifetime only; no routing, traffic or workflow authority

the adapter is not used by production composition or stored in the canonical Scene
one selected source per adapter is intentional until presentation identity prevents courier and route duplication
